entity_raw.definition_raw:
Other races have difficulty reading your wooden features.

Prerequisite(s): Wyrwood.

Benefit(s): Your lack of emotion make it difficult for non-wyrwoods to relate to you. When dealing with any race other than your own, you gain a +2 bonus on Bluff checks.

In addition, creatures of other races take a –2 penalty on Diplomacy and Sense Motive checks attempted against you.
